# data.docker_container

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Looks up one container on the provider's Docker host by ID or name, like `docker container inspect`. Use it for containers Terraform does not manage; the full inspect response is in `inspect` and `inspect_json`.

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `content_sha256` | `string` | computed |  |  | sha256 of inspect_json. |
| `docker_server_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Docker Engine version from GET /version. |
| `engine_api_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion). |
| `id` | `string` | optional, computed |  |  | Container ID (a unique prefix works). Set exactly one of `id` and `name`; the other is filled in. |
| `image_id` | `string` | computed |  |  | ID of the image the container was created from. |
| `inspect` | `object` | computed |  |  | The GET /containers/{id}/json response as a nested object, field by field. |
| `inspect_json` | `string` | computed |  | yes | The exact Engine API GET /containers/{id}/json response as JSON. |
| `labels` | `map(string)` | computed |  |  | Container labels (`Config.Labels`). |
| `name` | `string` | optional, computed |  |  | Container name, without the leading `/`. Set exactly one of `id` and `name`; the other is filled in. |

## Example

```terraform
# A container started outside Terraform, for example by a CI agent.
data "docker_container" "agent" {
  name = "ci-agent"
}

output "agent_image" {
  value = data.docker_container.agent.image_id
}

output "agent_running" {
  value = data.docker_container.agent.inspect.state.running
}
```
